text: dsh-meme 是面向 DSH Web 的表情包插件，在对话输入框加入可搜索、按图库与情绪筛选的贴图选择器，也能让模型根据对话气氛主动挑图。它提供图片发送、从用户图片学习并整理表情包、图库开关与管理、ZIP 导入导出和远程图库发现安装；agent 还可调用工具搜索图库、修改图片描述与分类。适合想在 DSH 对话或已接入的 IM 场景中使用梗图、维护个人图库的用户。需要 Node.js 22.13.0 或更高版本；使用内置图库不需要 API Key。

dsh-meme adds a searchable, mood-filtered sticker picker to DSH Web chat. Users can send and save images, manage libraries, import ZIP packs, and browse remote collections. Agents can search images and edit captions or categories. Requires Node.js 22.13.0+; the bundled pack needs no API key.

dsh-meme 的功能「输入框贴图选择器」：在 DSH 对话输入框附近打开选择器，按图库、情绪或关键词查找图片，预览后发送或插入标记。
dsh-meme 的功能「情绪贴图回复」：模型可依据设置的主动发送档位挑选契合对话气氛的图片；工具返回候选，Web 或已接入 IM 的渠道负责展示或发送。
dsh-meme 的功能「学习新表情」：调用 learn_meme 可收录最近一张用户图片或指定附件、图片 URL，并自动识别或接受手动指定的分类、描述和关键词。
dsh-meme 的功能「管理图库」：设置面板可查看、搜索、筛选图库图片，上传新图片，编辑分类、描述和关键词，或确认后删除图片。
dsh-meme 的功能「agent 图库工具」：meme_list 按关键词、分类或图库列出图片，meme_update 修改单张图片的索引元数据；图片本身不因此改变。
dsh-meme 的功能「图库 ZIP 导入导出」：用户可将图库打包或导入 ZIP，解析 STORE 与 DEFLATE 条目后纳入本地图库。
dsh-meme 的功能「发现远程图库」：管理面板读取图库目录，展示可用图库并提交下载或更新任务，供用户安装到本地。
dsh-meme 的功能「IM 图片发送」：存在 companionQq 发送能力时可注册发送工具；IM 场景通过图片路径交给集成渠道发送原生图片。
dsh-meme 使用远程目录和镜像读取图库目录、预览或图片资源；下载内容会写入本地图库目录。
dsh-meme 的 HTTP 路由默认限制回环 Host；若经反向代理访问，需明确配置可信主机名，局域网访问也需在设置中开启。

dsh-meme README · 功能：- 😊 **一键发图** — 输入框旁点 😊，搜索、按图库或情绪筛选，点一张直接发送；设置页可关掉「点图直接发送」，关闭后点一张只把 `[表情: 描述]` 插到输入框光标处，按回车和文字一起发出，手滑也不会误发。
- 🎭 **主动斗图** — AI 会按聊天情绪自己找图接梗，不用等你开口；设置页可选「主动发图」四档：关闭 / 看气氛 / 活跃 / 每轮都发，也能改写提示词调整风格。
- 📱 **IM / 手机斗图** — QQ、微信、飞书等经 dsh-im 接入后，表情包以原生图片消息发出，不用写文字标记；手机/平板经电脑局域网 IP 打开 DSH Web，设置页打开「局域网访问图库」即可收发（默认关）。QQ 大图容易被客户端当图片消息拉伸，可打开「QQ 发图尺寸」把发送副本缩到 200–450px，Web 仍用原图。
- 🧠 **学会新图** — 上传图片后说「把这张图入库」，AI 自动识别分类和描述；也可以把图片文件直接拷进图库目录，点「扫描新增」一键入库（动图 GIF 建议走这条，原始动画保留；文件改名/删除后扫描会顺手清理失效记录）。
- 🗂️ **整理图库** — 跟 AI 说「列一下表情包清单」「帮我查查重复」「把这张改成 work 分类」——内置 `meme_list` / `meme_update` 维护工具，改分类/描述/关键词不用手动翻面板（删除留在面板，防误删）。
- 📦 **管理与分享** — 多图库开关、上传与编辑、ZIP 导入导出、市场安装与更新。
- 🚀 **开箱即用** — 内置大肥鱼图库（24 张），核心功能零第三方运行依赖，使用 Node 内置 SQLite；QQ 缩图是可选能力（dsh-im 已自带 sharp，未安装时按原图发送）。

dsh-meme README · 图库管理：

**设置：发送方式、主动发图与图库目录**

默认扫描 `~/.dsh/meme-packs`，设置存 `~/.dsh/dsh-expression.json`，升级保留。ZIP 支持常规压缩和纯图片目录。

dsh-meme README · 图库管理：**发送方式**只影响 AI：自动按渠道（Web 写标记、IM 发原图）、纯文字不发图、图片要求每次真发。**主动发图**四档：关闭（只在你明确要图时发）、看气氛（默认，AI 自己判断）、活跃（大部分合适的回合都发）、每轮都发（提示词强制要求发一张）；仅在「自动」发送方式下生效，切换后新开会话生效，你明确要图时不受档位限制。**QQ 发图尺寸**默认关；打开后 QQ/IM 发送前把长边缩到所选尺寸（默认 300px），Web 聊天仍用原图，GIF 保留动画——QQ 官方机器人没有表情消息类型，缩小后更容易被客户端按表情渲染，平板端不会拉伸满屏。**表情排布**只影响前端：并排（默认）或图独占一行。

dsh-meme README · 常见问题：- **QQ 发表情被当大图拉伸** — QQ 官方机器人没有表情消息类型，大图会按图片消息渲染。设置页打开「QQ 发图尺寸」，选 300px（经验区间 200–450）后，QQ/IM 会发送缩小副本，Web 仍用原图；缩放需要 sharp，dsh-im 已自带，未安装时自动按原图发送。
- **更新失败 / 插件消失** — 先在市场点「重试」；仍失败就完全退出 DSH 后再更新。更早版本或仍失败，退出 DSH 后在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm add dsh-meme@latest`。图库和设置都在 `~/.dsh`，重装不丢。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **国内网络 / 市场拉不到** — 默认多镜像竞速 + 磁盘缓存，通常无需配置；拉不到时先在发现页点「重试」，再把「图库目录源」切到「镜像源」。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
- **手机 / 局域网 / 反向代理 / 子路径** — 局域网 IP 访问在设置页打开「局域网访问图库」；反代域名需显式声明可信 Host（`DSH_MEME_TRUSTED_HOSTS` 或 `allowedHosts`）；子路径部署（fnOS `/app/<id>/`、Nginx `location /dsh/` 等）从 0.1.77 起自动适配，无需配置。详见 [排障手册](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)。
dsh-meme README · 分享自己的图库：在「图库」新建图包库并加图 → **导出** ZIP 给朋友 **导入**。想进市场就点 **投稿**，按预填表单附上 ZIP、图片来源与许可。请用插件导出的 ZIP；GitHub 的「Download ZIP」是源码包，不能替代图库包。

dsh-meme README · 工具与扩展：| 工具 | 用法 |
| --- | --- |
| `send_meme` | 按情绪 `tag` 随机抽图，或按 `query` 搜描述/关键词/文件名；跨所有启用图库，候选带 `path`（磁盘绝对路径）/ `library`，IM 场景另有 `absPath`；没命中时返回真实分类统计 |
| `learn_meme` | 收录最近一张用户图片，也可指定 `attachmentId` / `imageUrl`；附件 GIF 被压成单帧时会提示 |
| `meme_list` | 跨启用图库按关键词/分类/图库筛清单，带所属图库、分类、描述、关键词和 path |
| `meme_update` | 改一张图的分类/描述/关键词（只改索引不动文件）；path 用 `meme_list` / `send_meme` 的原样 |

```text
send_meme tag=happy
send_meme query="猫 比心"
learn_meme
meme_list tag=work

dsh-meme README · 工具与扩展：情绪桶：`happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `shy` / `confused` / `daily`。模型应把候选里的 `[表情: 描述]` 原样写进回复；没有合适的候选就换关键词或纯文字回复。

**给 agent 的说明**：包内 `AGENTS.md` 写了发图判定、path 前缀和 GIF 压平的坑；图库整理流程在 skill `.dsh/skills/dsh-meme-maintenance` 里。设置页可直接查看/编辑。

**动图读取**：`learn_meme` 和上传识图会把 GIF 采样成多帧胶片条再送模型，caption 能描述动作；原图仍保留动画。WebP / APNG 只读元数据、按第一帧识别。

dsh-meme README · IM 投递：经 [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im) 接入后，`send_meme` 候选带绝对路径，模型调用 `dsh_im_return_file` 发原生图片；Web 聊天仍用 `[表情: 描述]`。通过 [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) 也可接 QQ。

dsh-meme README · QQ 官方机器人：对 [dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) 会话，候选带 `absPath`，交给 `qqbot_send_file` 的 `file_path`。dsh-qqbot 默认有路径白名单，需要把图库目录加进 `sendFile.extraRoots`：

```yaml

dsh-meme README · qqbot profile 的 cordis.patch.yml（或「设置 → QQ 机器人」）：- id: im-qqbot
  config:
    sendFile:
      extraRoots:
        - C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\meme-packs
        - C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-meme\memes
```

`C:\Users\<你>` 在 Linux/macOS 上换成 `~`；图库放哪就加哪个目录，内置图库的路径也要加。

| 方法 | 返回 |

| `packs()` | 已启用图库 `{ id, name, count, path }[]` |
| `search({ query, tag, limit })` | `{ ok, query, memes: [{ path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }] }` |

`tag` 是情绪桶；未命中时 `tagStats` 给出真实分类分布。返回的 `path` 是磁盘绝对路径且文件存在。自建图库目录或市场源见 [远程图库规范](./docs/remote-pack-spec.md)。

dsh-meme README · Features：- 😊 **Click to send** — open 😊 beside the composer, search or filter by pack and mood, and pick an image to send it. Turn off “Click to send” in settings and picking only inserts the marker at your caret, so text and sticker go out together on Enter without accidental sends.
- 🎭 **Proactive memes** — the AI picks a meme that fits the conversation's mood without waiting to be asked; choose a proactive-meme level (off / by mood / active / every turn) or edit the prompt in settings.
- 📱 **IM / mobile** — through dsh-im, QQ / WeChat / Feishu and other IM chats send memes as native images with no text marker; on a phone or tablet, open DSH Web over your computer's LAN IP and turn on “Allow LAN access” (off by default). QQ tends to render large images as photos (stretched full-screen on tablets); turn on “QQ send size” in settings to send a 200–450 px copy while Web keeps the original.
- 🧠 **Learn new images** — upload an image and ask to save it; the AI identifies its category and caption. You can also drop image files into a pack folder and click “扫描新增 (Scan)” — the original bytes (including animated GIFs) are kept, and renamed/deleted files have their stale

dsh-meme README · Manage packs：

The default scan directory is `~/.dsh/meme-packs`; settings live in `~/.dsh/dsh-expression.json` and survive upgrades. ZIP imports accept standard compression and plain image folders.

dsh-meme README · Manage packs：**Send mode** only affects the AI: automatic follows the channel (Web marker, IM native image), text-only never sends images, image requires a real send every time. **Proactive memes** has four levels: off (only when you ask for one), by mood (default, the AI decides), active (most suitable turns), and every turn (the prompt requires one); they apply only in automatic send mode, take effect in a new session, and a direct request always bypasses the level. **QQ send size** is off by default; when enabled, QQ/IM sends a copy scaled to the selected long edge (300 px default), Web keeps the original, and GIF frames are preserved — the official QQ bot has no sticker message type, and smaller images are more likely to render as stickers instead of being stretched full-screen on tablets. **Layout** only affects rendering: side-by-side (default) or a full-width image row.

dsh-meme README · Troubleshooting：- **QQ renders memes as stretched photos** — the official QQ bot has no sticker message type, so large images are sent as photos. Turn on “QQ send size” and pick 300 px (200–450 works best); QQ/IM then sends a scaled copy while Web keeps the original. Scaling needs sharp, which dsh-im bundles; without it the original image is sent.
- **Update failed / plugin disappeared** — click **Retry** in the marketplace; if it still fails, quit DSH completely and update again. On older versions, or if it keeps failing, run `pnpm add dsh-meme@latest` in the profile directory with DSH closed. Packs and settings live in `~/.dsh` and survive reinstalls. See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).
- **Restrictive network / marketplace unavailable** — mirrors are raced and the catalog is cached automatically; click **Retry**, then switch **Catalog source** to **Mirrors**. See the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).
- **Phone / LAN / reverse proxy / sub-path** — turn on **Allow LAN access** for LAN IPs; a reverse-proxy domain needs an explicit

dsh-meme README · Share your own pack：Create a pack, add images, click **导出 (Export)** and send the ZIP; friends install it with **导入图库 (Import pack)**. To join the marketplace, click **投稿 (Submit)** and attach the ZIP with image sources and licence details in the prefilled GitHub form. Use the plugin's exported ZIP — GitHub's “Download ZIP” is a source archive, not a pack.

dsh-meme README · Tools and extensions：| Tool | Usage |
| --- | --- |
| `send_meme` | `tag` samples a mood bucket, `query` searches captions/keywords/file names across enabled packs; candidates carry `path` (absolute on disk) / `library`, plus `absPath` for IM, and a miss returns real category counts |
| `learn_meme` | Saves the latest user image by default; also accepts `attachmentId` / `imageUrl`; warns when an attached GIF was flattened |
| `meme_list` | Read-only listing across enabled packs by keyword/category/pack, with pack, category, caption, keywords and path |
| `meme_update` | Change one image's category/caption/keywords (index only); pass the path exactly as returned by `meme_list` / `send_meme` |

dsh-meme README · Tools and extensions：```text
send_meme tag=happy
send_meme query="猫 比心"
learn_meme
meme_list tag=work

Mood buckets: `happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `shy` / `confused` / `daily`. The model should copy a candidate's `[表情: caption]` verbatim; if nothing fits, retry with other words or reply with text.

**Agent docs**: `AGENTS.md` documents per-channel sending, path prefixes and the GIF-flattening caveat; pack maintenance lives in the skill `.dsh/skills/dsh-meme-maintenance`. The settings page can view/edit it.

dsh-meme README · Tools and extensions：**Animated GIFs**: `learn_meme` and upload recognition sample GIF frames into a filmstrip, so captions describe motion; the original keeps animating. WebP / APNG contribute metadata only and are recognized from the first frame.

dsh-meme README · IM delivery：Through [dsh-im](https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im), `send_meme` candidates carry absolute paths and the model calls `dsh_im_return_file`; Web chats keep `[表情: caption]`. [dsh-companion](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-companion) also provides QQ delivery.

dsh-meme README · Official QQ bot：For [dsh-qqbot](https://github.com/tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot) sessions, candidates carry `absPath` for `qqbot_send_file`'s `file_path`. dsh-qqbot's path allowlist needs your pack directories in `sendFile.extraRoots`:

```yaml

dsh-meme README · the qqbot profile's cordis.patch.yml (or Settings → QQ bot)：- id: im-qqbot
  config:
    sendFile:
      extraRoots:
        - C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\meme-packs
        - C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\<profile>\node_modules\dsh-meme\memes
```

Replace `C:\Users\<you>` with `~` on Linux/macOS; include the bundled pack's path too.
section: the qqbot profile's cordis.patch.yml (or Settings → QQ bot)

dsh-meme README · Read-only meme service for other plugins：Other plugins in the same process can call `ctx.get('dshMeme')` (read-only):

| Method | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `packs()` | Enabled packs `{ id, name, count, path }[]` |
| `search({ query, tag, limit })` | `{ ok, query, memes: [{ path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }] }` |
| `pick({ query, tag })` | On a hit `{ ok: true, path, tag, caption, keywords, pack, packName }`; otherwise `{ ok: false, reason, tags, tagStats }` |
section: Read-only meme service for other plugins

dsh-meme README · Read-only meme service for other plugins：`tag` is a mood bucket; `tagStats` gives the real category distribution on a miss. Every returned `path` is absolute and exists. For custom catalogs see the [remote pack specification](./docs/remote-pack-spec.md).

Plugin HTTP routes accept loopback hosts by default; LAN and reverse-proxy setup is in the [troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.en.md).

dsh-meme README · Development：Plain ESM, no build step. Clone the repository and run the tests:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme.git
cd dsh-meme
npm test
```

Tests use Node's built-in runner (`node --test test/*.test.mjs`) and should be green before a release. With a `link:` install into a profile, restart DSH to pick up changes. Agent-facing conventions live in [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md).
